locations.name: Highcrown
locations.kind: Royal Capital City
locations.description: Ethoria's besieged Royal Capital in the green Crownlands heartland—home to Highcrown Keep, the Great Coliseum where Koren fell, and the overgrown palace gardens above the dry aqueducts.

quests.title: Seal the Aqueduct Grate
quests.description: During the months of unrest after Garrick abandoned Highcrown, rogue kennel trackers pried open the neglected dry aqueduct grate behind Highcrown's overgrown palace gardens, letting war-hounds prowl beneath the Coliseum undercroft. Descend through the garden grate, defeat the Garrick Houndmaster and his wolves guarding the culvert control chamber, and pull the gate lever to seal the breach shut.

quests.title: Salvage Koren's Forge-Kit
quests.description: During the succession riots that rocked Highcrown before Garrick fled north, Coliseum armorers stashed heavy repair trunks—including tools forged for Koren—along the brushwood hollow just beyond the outer capital road. Clear the opportunistic bandits looting the wreck and bring the steel back to Highcrown.

quests.title: Highcrown Perimeter Watch
quests.description: Capital scouts spotted smoke rising behind a crumbling ivy-covered limestone wall just outside Highcrown, where deserters in Garrick's gray war-cloaks have stacked spears and crossbows around a hidden campfire to plot their next move. Ambush the forward camp and break up the plot before they act.

quests.title: Word to Oakhaven
quests.description: Carry Highcrown's wax-sealed royal dispatch up the Crownlands trade road to Oakhaven's elder. Poachers and turncoat deserters have thrown up shield barricades along the bend to intercept every courier riding north from the capital.

locations.playerDescription: Ethoria's storied capital rises above terraced gardens, dry stone aqueducts, and the soot-stained tiers of the Great Coliseum. Though King Garrick's shadow hangs heavy over the realm, loyal banners still hold the Highcrown walls.

locations.name: Oakhaven
locations.kind: Walled Town
locations.description: Walled Crownlands heartland entry town with blacksmith anvil, armory, town tourney ring, mystic shop, and free inn.

quests.title: Missing Grain Carts
quests.description: Loaded grain wagons bound for Oakhaven vanished before dawn along the fenced dirt lanes outside town. Track the spilled wheat sacks to the ambushed bend and defeat the bandit wagon-boss's crew to recover the grain.

quests.title: Boy in the Fold
quests.description: A young shepherd boy chased a stray lamb into the deep woods after wolves scattered his flock. Track the pawprints to the pack's mossy wolf den among the trees and bring the boy home alive.

quests.title: Forged Rivets for the Palisade
quests.description: Haul crates of hardened iron gate-rivets toward Millbrook Crossing's western palisade. Halfway up the lane, rogue animated armor drawn by stray Portal sparks has smashed the lead handcart across the oak road.

quests.title: Bandits at the Old Orchard
quests.description: Armed highwaymen have turned the abandoned apple orchard outside Oakhaven into a toll hideout and cider-cellar ambush. Clear their orchard camp under the fruit trees so harvest wagons can pass unmolested.

quests.title: Poachers on the Meadow Trail
quests.description: Snare-wires and mauled deer carcasses line the game trails outside Oakhaven. Track the scarred trail into the deep oak grove where an enraged dire boar has gored both poachers and travelers alike.

locations.playerDescription: Sheltered beneath ancient oaks behind stout fieldstone walls, Oakhaven thrives on ringing forge-hammers, harvest granaries, and lively courtyard bouts. Folk across the meadows still gather at its hearthfires for news from the capital.

locations.name: Millbrook Crossing
locations.kind: Dryland Frontier Village
locations.description: Dry frontier windmill and wagon-crossroads village in the deeper half of Zone 2.

quests.title: Hold the West Palisade
quests.description: Arsonists wearing turncoat garrison colors are gathering oil flasks outside Millbrook's wooden western gatehouse. Stand at the sharpened timber palisade stakes and break the sergeant's night assault.

quests.title: Shattered Mill-Tower
quests.description: Winged stone gargoyles shaken loose from eastern shrines have nested atop the cracked ridge windmill spire overlooking Millbrook. Head up to the bluff ruins and defeat the alpha stone gargoyle roosting above the broken sails.

quests.title: Chain D1: The Scarred Name
quests.description: A loud-mouthed bounty hunter bragging about sealed papers tracing Koren's earliest transfer from the northern border war-pits to Highcrown's Great Coliseum made camp along the muddy woodland road outside Millbrook. Raid the campfire stockade and seize the transfer dossier.

quests.title: Dust Mephits in the Old Mine Shack
quests.description: Billowing ash vents have choked the old limestone quarry shaft north of Millbrook with giggling dust mephits. Seal the quarry vent and sweep the blinding swarm out of the timber shoring.

quests.title: Lost Courier on the North Ridge
quests.description: The hill-fort dispatch rider's horse galloped back into Millbrook alone with chitin gashes down its flank. Follow the ridge trail to the ankheg burrows and defeat the beast to bring the wounded rider home.

locations.playerDescription: Built by Crownlands millers and limestone masons beneath creaking windmill sails. Now weary travelers gather round its hearthfires while raiders prowl outside the palisade and ash vents stir nearby chalk-pits.

locations.name: The Ashen Gate
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #1
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #1 in Zone 3 (Lv 11–15) of the Crownlands. Charred basalt archway linking to Earth & Forge — requires the Ashen Forge Keystone catalyst from Saltwind Harbor's Cracked Lighthouse.
locations.playerDescription: A towering arch of scorched basalt humming with furnace heat from Earth and Forge. Ancient smith-wards bar the way; sailors whisper its lost keystone sank near Saltwind's reefs.

locations.name: Saltwind Harbor
locations.kind: Port Town (Ship Port)
locations.description: Fortified coastal port city on the northern bay linking Ethoria's Saltmarsh coast approach, featuring a dockside fighting pit.

quests.title: Chain A1: Ledgers in the Brine
quests.description: Black-market slavers hid Mera's mother's shipping manifest inside a ruined tidal belltower chapel perched along the muddy coastal tidal flats. Best the massive chuul haunting the sunken steps and claim the waterproof ledger.

quests.title: Pier Three Blockade
quests.description: Hired thugs trying to cripple Saltwind's continent-sailing fleet have barricaded the stone-and-timber drydock slipway. Guard the harbor carpenters while they finish rigging the sea-hull for open-water voyages.

quests.title: The Cracked Lighthouse
quests.reward: 375s | 560 XP + Ashen Forge Keystone | Lesser Draft
quests.description: Thermal fissures linked to The Ashen Gate drew boiling steam mephits and harpoon-armed merrow into Saltwind's northern cliffside lighthouse, where they hoard the glowing Ashen Forge Keystone needed to open Portal #1. Clear the lighthouse tower, reclaim the catalyst, and restore the harbor beam.

quests.title: Sunken Tide-Cargo
quests.description: Waterproof ironbound crates stamped with merchant guild seals washed onto the beach flats south of Saltwind. Slay the acid-spitting black dragon wyrmling nesting over the stranded rowboat and recover the guild cargo.

quests.title: Harbor-Master's Beach Salvage
quests.description: A storm-broken merchant vessel lies wedged high upon the outer golden sandbar holding crucial sea charts for Map 2's coast. Fend off coastal scavengers and retrieve the captain's brass chart cylinder.

locations.playerDescription: Weathered sandstone seawalls embrace deep emerald waters where merchant galleons unload timber, salt, and rumor from distant shores. Battered dockside fighting rings draw bold blades between high tides.

locations.name: Mirewatch Post
locations.kind: Frontier Outpost
locations.description: Elevated swamp-edge timber outpost deep in the Saltmarsh wetlands.

quests.title: Swamp-Fever Antitoxin
quests.description: Fever is spreading fast through Saltwind's wounded watchmen, and an armored chuul snapped the apothecary wagon's axle on the dry cobble trail mid-fen. Clear the monster from the road and get the remaining antitoxin moving.

quests.title: Water Weirds in the Cistern
quests.description: Portal energy seeping through groundwater has animated the garrison's main stone drinking cistern outside the wooden palisade. Banish the surging elemental so Mirewatch's garrison can draw clean water again.

quests.title: Chuul Nest in the Fen
quests.description: Missing fen trackers never vanish without leaving half-eaten steel helmets behind. Trace deep pincer furrows across the peat mound to slay the breeding chuul pair before their clutch hatches.

quests.title: Ambush at the Ferry Landing
quests.description: A screeching gibbering mouther crawled up onto the western strait ferry shore, trapping the boat crew behind coiled timber crates. Break the aberrant horror before it drags the ferrymen into the surf.

quests.title: Lost Admiralty Chest
quests.description: When coastal patrols abandoned the outer stone excise bank, they buried a locked payroll chest beneath the foundation flagstones. Drive off the beasts guarding the ruined wall and recover the admiralty silver.

locations.playerDescription: Raised on heavy oak pilings above whispering reeds and dark brackish pools, Mirewatch shelters marsh wardens and herbalists braving the deep fens. Smudge fires burn day and night against venomous fog and bog horrors.

locations.name: The Sunken Maw
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #2
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #2 in Zone 5 (Lv 21–25) of the Saltmarsh Coast. Standing tidal archway into deep abyssal waters — requires the Abyssal Brine-Pearl catalyst from Tidewater Keep's Shellback Shore Bluff.

bossInfo.plane: Elemental Plane of Water & Deep Trench

locations.playerDescription: Barnacle-crusted tidal monoliths form a drowned sea-arch pulsing with cold abyssal light from the Plane of Water. Sea captains speak of a luminous brine-pearl guarded by beasts near Tidewater's outer cliffs.

locations.name: Redmarch Bastion
locations.kind: Border Garrison Town
locations.description: Fortified border garrison town guarding Thornwall Warfronts with frontier war-steel and a bailey gladiatorial ring.

quests.title: Deserters' Armory
quests.description: Deserters who bolted during the border skirmishes hauled away three racks of garrison halberds and shields into a jagged slate canyon outside Redmarch. Best the towering minotaur mercenary guarding their canyon camp.

quests.title: Sealed Border Dispatches
quests.description: Carry Redmarch's sealed troop-rotation cipher up the golden-grass highland track to the ridge relay picket. Hungry iron-furred worgs have pinned the signalmen inside the cliffside timber shelter.

quests.title: Worg Packs on the Supply Trail
quests.description: Cunning highland worgs speaking broken commands have been herding pack horses off Redmarch's supply road at dusk. Hunt down the scarred alpha along the golden ochre boulder field.

quests.title: Cove Supply Convoy
quests.description: A heavy supply galleon unloading war crates along Thornwall's cove shore ran hard aground while deserters moved in to loot the hold. Break the deserter platoon swarming the beached spice-and-iron cargo.

quests.title: Salvage the Lost War-Wagons
quests.description: Ogre mercenaries smashed a siege train along the broken low stone road-wall near Redmarch, claiming the wagons as club wood. Topple the two ogres and recover the intact iron siege axles.

locations.playerDescription: Red-gray ashlar battlements rise proudly above sunlit ochre meadows where royal regiments muster against highland treachery. Its iron portcullis opens onto busy armor halls, crowded inns, and a sand-strewn garrison ring.

locations.name: Hollowstone Keep
locations.kind: Rival House Stronghold
locations.description: Noble highland stronghold of Rival House Hollowstone contesting King Garrick's vacant throne, featuring an inner tourney duel yard.

quests.title: Chain C2: Fall of House Hollowstone
quests.description: With Thornwall behind you, storm the great war-hall inside Hollowstone Keep's outer curtain wall. Defeat the scheming traitor Lord Hollowstone and his chained ettin bodyguard to claim the usurper's family signet.

quests.title: Prisoners in the Bailey Dungeon
quests.description: A repentant warden leaked word that loyalist Border Guard knights are trapped beneath Hollowstone's lower outer bailey cells. Defeat the rival knights guarding the prison stair to free the captives.

quests.title: Secret War-Pact Ledgers
quests.description: Twenty years of black-wax quarantine orders—dated back to King Garrick's first frontier campaign—lie sealed inside the high archive tower under an oni assassin's watch. Slay the fiendish scribe and seize the ledgers proving Garrick's 'border wars' quietly fought encroaching non-human forces while suppressing word of magic inside Highcrown.

quests.title: Rogue Troll Patrol
quests.description: Wild highland trolls hired by House Hollowstone refused to stand down after the keep changed hands, raiding supply carts from a nearby slate gully. Defeat the troll pack guarding their camp to secure the warfront hills.

quests.title: Shatter the Stone-Giant Picket
quests.description: A massive stone giant champion loyal to the Blood-Iron Warlands fortified a granite hillside redoubt overlooking the warfront, guarding the forged Blood-Iron Keystone needed to open Portal #3. Topple the champion and claim the catalyst for The Iron Rift.

locations.playerDescription: Spired in dark slate and draped in wine-purple silk, House Hollowstone's fortress defies the crown behind spiked gates and a tourney yard. Whispers tell of captives locked beneath its walls.

locations.name: The Iron Rift
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #3
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #3 in Zone 8 (Lv 36–40) of Thornwall Warfronts. Forged-iron archway into Blood-Iron Warlands — requires the Blood-Iron Keystone catalyst from Hollowstone Keep's Iron-Rift Giant Redoubt.
locations.playerDescription: Riveted iron girders and scarred granite jambs frame a blistering gateway roaring with war-drums from the Blood-Iron Warlands. Rumors among captured quarrymen trace its molten seal to stone-giant pickets guarding the high crags.

locations.name: Briarstead
locations.kind: Forest Town
locations.description: Timber-palisade forest town famous for apothecaries, hunters, woodland tourney ring, and frontier Weald-border gear.

quests.title: Chain B1: The Spreading Blight
quests.description: Dark purple fungal tendrils erupting out of the stone well beside an old roadside chapel beyond Briarstead are choking travelers with spores. Defeat the violet spore-colony at the shrine so Harlan can trace the blight's origin.

quests.title: Poultices for the Sawyers
quests.description: Carry fever-breaking herb poultices through the pine woods toward Timberfall Village. Along the way, corrosive black puddings and sprawling violet fungus have overrun an outer logging clearing.

quests.title: Blink-Dog Ambush on the Herb Trail
quests.description: Maddened teleporting blink dogs frightened out of the corrupted deeper woods keep vanishing in flashes of mist to raid herbalist wagons leaving Briarstead. Hold the trail and scatter the erratic pack.

quests.title: Briar-Root Harvest
quests.description: Every healing draught in Briarstead relies on rare white briar-roots pulled from sunlit moss-ringed oak hollows. Clear away the towering awakened dread-tree guarding the grove and fill the apothecary's baskets.

quests.title: Wolves in the Apiary Woods
quests.description: Predators fleeing creeping blight spores have broken open the woodland honey-yards outside Briarstead, scattering the town's skeps. Drive out the rabid wolf and tusked boar pack trampling the hives.

locations.playerDescription: Sweet dried sage, pine resin, and beeswax hang beneath steep timber gables inside this sanctuary walled against the ancient woods. Healers and woodsfolk fill its square while darker spores begin creeping out from deeper groves.

locations.name: The Rotspire
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #4
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #4 in Zone 10 (Lv 46–50) of the Plague Woods. Moss-bound stone archway into the Corrupted Feywild — requires the Spore-Heart Amber catalyst from Blightwatch Keep's Rotspire Approach Gate.
locations.playerDescription: Gnarled roots and luminous lichen coil around a sunken forest arch choking the surrounding canopy with sickly emerald spores. Quarantine chaplains believe only hardened amber plucked from the quarantine gate can pierce its seal.

locations.name: Port Veridia
locations.kind: Island Port Town (Ship Port)
locations.description: Sun-bleached coastal spice-trade port city linking sea routes across the Sun-Scorched Isles, featuring a desert coastal fighting arena.

quests.title: Chain A2: The Smuggler's Crossing
quests.description: The shipping ledgers recovered back in Saltwind Harbor point to an illicit night-pier along the coast near Port Veridia. Ambush the Gilded Slaver Quartermaster on the sandstone quay and force the location of Mera's mother.

quests.title: Silk & Cinders
quests.description: Elemental magma fissures split wide beneath the spice guild's seaside stone depot, spilling fiery salamanders among priceless silk bales. Purge the fire-born invaders and seal the glowing floor crack.

quests.title: Stone-Eyed Coast
quests.description: Missing net-crews along the amber sea-cliffs vanished at a coastal camp where a basking brood-mother basilisk petrifies unwary fishermen. Defeat the basilisk at the cliff shelter to break its hold over the surviving scouts.

quests.title: Break the Corsair Pier
quests.description: Outfitted with black sails, the Gilded Commodore grounded his corsair brigantine on the golden cove outside Port Veridia to shell incoming relief merchants. Storm the beached hull and break the blockade.

quests.title: Scorpion Infestation in the Docks
quests.description: Dockworkers unloading cinnamon shipments from overseas barges uncovered burrowing giant scorpions nesting underneath torn spice sacks. Crush the venomous brood-mother lurking inside the outer sandstone yard.

locations.playerDescription: Pale limestone arcades draped in saffron and sea-teal silks look across gleaming turquoise waters thick with spice galleons and trader barges. Behind the bazaar clang blades inside a sun-baked coastal fighting ring.

locations.name: Dunespire Oasis
locations.kind: Frontier Oasis Outpost
locations.description: Sheltered desert oasis hub ringed by woven merchant tents around a clear palm spring.

quests.title: Tremors Under the Sand
quests.description: Tremors cracking the old sandstone outer wells herald a colossal purple worm churning beneath Dunespire's desert floor. Lure the subterranean titan to the wellhead rim and slay it before the oasis basin collapses.

quests.title: Prism Echoes
quests.description: Heat fused a jagged desert canyon cave into humming pillars of amber and ruby storm-glass around an ancient City-of-Brass anvil. Enter the crystal gallery, defeat the bronze-bearded azer smith, and recover the prism core.

quests.title: Guard the Oasis Spring
quests.description: Blazing fire elementals marching out from The Scorched Chasm aim to boil dry the palm feeder spring that keeps every desert traveler alive. Stand beside the limestone spring walls and extinguish the flaming vanguard.

quests.title: Mummy Tomb Beneath the Dunes
quests.description: Earthquakes split open a forgotten sandstone burial stair among the dunes near Dunespire, waking linen-wrapped desert mummies and their silver-tongued lamia guardian. Cleanse the sunken tomb before sand-plague sweeps the caravans.

quests.title: Lost Desert Travelers
quests.description: Three water-bearers lured out past the sandstone arch by desert mirages are pinned beneath overhanging rocks by a fire-breathing chimera. Slay the triple-headed stalker and escort the dehydrated travelers home.

locations.playerDescription: Woven merchant tents and brass lanterns circle a jewel-clear palm spring shimmering amidst endless dunes. Scholars pore over ancient desert ruins by candlelight while guards watch the sandbars for burrowing terrors.

locations.name: The Gilded Auction Manor
locations.kind: Rival Slaver Estate
locations.description: Fortified sandstone estate and gladiator blood-pit of the Slaver Baron where Mera's mother is held captive (Chain A Climax).

quests.title: Chain A3: Broken Shackles
quests.description: Every ledger and whisper leads straight into the Slaver Baron's golden vault courtyard. Bring down the Baron and his prized chimera hound, shatter the iron cages, and finally reunite Mera with her mother.

quests.title: Seize the Collar Ledgers
quests.description: Dozens of missing Ethorians were sold to distant buyers before you arrived. Storm the manor's outer colonnade clerk wing to capture the full buyer manifests so every captive can be traced.

quests.title: Disable the Holding Pens
quests.description: Even with the Baron cornered, his elemental brass azer jailer holds the key-ring to the heavy iron outer courtyard cages. Defeat the fiery overseer in battle to liberate the remaining captives.

quests.title: Guard Against Efreeti Scouts
quests.description: Outraged that their gold-for-captives bargain collapsed, fire-Plane wyrmlings and elemental scouts pitched a desert ash-camp guarding the Brass Cinder-Seal catalyst needed to open Portal #5. Break their vanguard and reclaim the catalyst for The Scorched Chasm.

locations.playerDescription: Ornate hammered-bronze domes and high spiked walls conceal the Slaver Syndicate's brutal gilded stronghold and sand-pit yard. Beyond the locked iron gates whisper informants longing to shatter the cartel's chains forever.

locations.name: The Scorched Chasm
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #5
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #5 in Zone 13 (Lv 61–65) of the Sun-Scorched Isles. Sandstone & brass archway to the City of Brass — requires the Brass Cinder-Seal catalyst from The Gilded Auction Manor's Scorched Chasm Scout Nest.

bossInfo.plane: Elemental Plane of Fire (City of Brass)

locations.playerDescription: A towering sun-blistered arch of sandstone and tarnished brass radiating furnace gusts from the Elemental Plane of Fire. Caravan elders tell of a brass cinder-seal carried off by fire-born raiders prowling near the gilded cliffs.

locations.name: Highpass Refuge
locations.kind: Alpine Cliff Town
locations.description: Alpine cliff town terraced along sunny foothill mountain ridges with a cobbled duel ring ahead of the Ironcrest ferry.

quests.title: Granite Scree Pass
quests.description: Shrieking storm mephits and harpies have been loosing giant granite scree boulders down onto Highpass's lower trail. Clear the scree-strewn green alpine ridge before another slide cuts town off.

quests.title: Star-Iron Ingots
quests.description: Haul raw black meteoric ore along the sunny green highland road leading to Anvilhall Forge's great granite doors. A colossal sky-roc swooped out of the storm clouds and flipped the ore cart.

quests.title: Blood-Hawk Roosts
quests.description: Giant crimson-feathered raptors nested atop the gray-granite outcrops directly above Highpass Refuge's goat folds, diving on shepherds at noon. Defeat the blood-hawk and giant eagle flock threatening the town pastures.

quests.title: Missing Foothill Caravan
quests.description: Whirling tempest spirits hurled down gray boulders to pin a merchant's team below the sunny alpine pass. Shatter the howling air elementals circling the overturned wagon and pull the injured drivers free.

quests.title: Guard the Highland Storehouses
quests.description: Screaming harpies and barbed manticores are swooping over Highpass's unfortified outer slate storage terrace to tear into winter salt beef crates. Defend the outer provision yards until doors are bolted.

locations.playerDescription: Steep slate-shingled homes cling cleanly across lush green mountain ridges above clear highland valleys and pine gorges. Mountaineers trade raw star-iron and warm hearthfire before climbing the upper crags.

locations.name: Anvilhall Forge
locations.kind: Mountain Keep & Master Forge
locations.description: Legendary granite mountain smithy housing a guild trial-by-combat ring, Gear Tier 17 armaments, and Tier-6 master spells.

quests.title: The Missing Envoy
quests.description: Anvilhall's sealed weapons-treaty courier ducked into the star-iron tunnel of Ironvein Cavern during a storm and never walked back out. Hunt the unseen air stalker prowling the blue-veined granite galleries.

quests.title: Meteoric Core Slabs
quests.description: A heavy fallen star-iron boulder punched a smoking pit across the granite highlands near Anvilhall and attracted an electricity-charged storm behir. Defeat the beast at the impact crater and recover the meteoric core slab.

quests.title: Defend the Granite Foundry
quests.description: Whirlwind-riding djinni raiders swooped down onto Anvilhall's carved exterior granite stairways to snuff the furnace bellows and loot master-forged blades. Hold the smithy terrace steps against their tempest assault.

quests.title: Clear the High-Ridge Ore Track
quests.description: Huge saber-toothed ridge tigers dragged draft mules straight out of harnesses along the sunny pine ore-track climbing out of Anvilhall. Hunt down the sleek mated pair blocking heavy charcoal deliveries.

quests.title: Chimney-Vent Tempests
quests.description: Gale-force gusts spiraling down Anvilhall's upper stone mountain chimneys nearly suffocated three apprentices inside the smelting room. Hike up to the windy chimney flue vents and disperse the howling invisible stalkers.

locations.playerDescription: Hollowed straight from living highland granite, roaring bellows and cascading sparks illuminate rows of legendary armor and an inner trial ring. Smiths from across Ethoria revere its ancient anvils above all others.

locations.name: The Storm-Crowned Spire
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #6
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #6 in Zone 15 (Lv 71–75) of Ironcrest Highlands. Granite terrace archway into the Dragon Crags — requires the Storm-Crown Lodestone catalyst from Stormhold Citadel's Storm-Spire Giant Terrace.

bossInfo.plane: Elemental Plane of Air & Dragon Crags

locations.playerDescription: Crackling sky-bolts dance across a carved granite gateway opening toward the windswept Elemental Plane of Air and Dragon Crags. Rangers below Stormhold's walls tell of storm-giants hoarding the gate's crackling lodestone.

locations.name: Rimeport
locations.kind: Northern Port Town (Ship Port)
locations.description: Ice-locked sea port city linking sea ships, an ice-harbor fighting pit, Tier-7 spells, and northern frost-forged gear.

quests.title: Frozen Beacon
quests.description: Winged spined devils drove keepers from Rimeport's snow-draped coastal headland tower so supply ships strike icebergs in the fog. Defeat the flying fiends atop the headland so harbor wardens can relight the signal.

quests.title: Hellfire on the Sea-Wall
quests.description: Flaming infernal steeds and bearded devils are galloping straight across Rimeport's snow-packed cobbled approach to smash the harbor wall portcullis. Stand in the archway and shatter the fiendish cavalry charge.

quests.title: Sunken Warships
quests.description: A royal northern flagship dashed itself onto the snowy granite beach shelf of Whispering Fjord with encrypted fleet cipher books locked in its stern cabin. Fight past the horned devil reaver scavenging the hull.

quests.title: Supply Ledgers to Frostmere
quests.description: Rimeport's winter supply sled carrying silver requisitions for Frostmere Village was overrun along the frozen pine road. Fight off the frost-breathing winter wolf pack and carry the courier satchel to Frostmere's gate.

quests.title: Shadows in the Drydock
quests.description: Winged Erinyes executioners and creeping shadow demons slipped onto Rimeport's frozen timber slipway to slaughter night-watch shipwrights and burn hull-pitch stores. Sweep the drydock clean so repairs can resume.

locations.playerDescription: Ice-locked timber quays and glowing coal braziers welcome hardy sailors braving drifting glacial floes. Thick-bundled shipwrights hammer frozen oak planks beside a roaring harbor fighting pit.

locations.name: Bleakwatch Citadel
locations.kind: Rival Warlord Fortress
locations.description: Snow-swept warlord fortress and ice fighting pit of Marshal Bleakwatch, last rival throne-claimant (Chain C Climax).

quests.title: Chain C3: The Northern Pretender
quests.description: Marshal Bleakwatch—Garrick's frontier confidant who buried twenty years of battles against encroaching non-human forces under censored border dispatches—now allies with infernal powers to claim Ethoria's broken crown. Strike down the conspirator and his ice-devil bodyguard in the courtyard to reclaim the Crown-Shard.

quests.title: Garrison Hostages in the Keep
quests.description: Twenty northern jarl loyalists are trapped inside iron cells beneath Bleakwatch's frost-coated drawbridge gatehouse. Defeat the rival knights and barbed devil jailers guarding the gate to free the hostages.

quests.title: Shatter the Nightmare Stables
quests.description: Infernal flaming steeds melt patches straight into Bleakwatch's outer snowbank stables whenever hell-knights ride out. Slay the winged horned grooms and put the terrifying nightmare herd down.

quests.title: Infernal Pact Braziers
quests.description: Bleakwatch's sorcerers maintain three crimson summoning braziers along the outer stone spur to summon reinforcements out of the Nine Hells. Defeat the glabrezu and succubus tending the ritual terrace to halt their summoning.

quests.title: Gatekeepers of the Abyss
quests.description: A hardened vanguard of horned and ice devils fortified a snow-choked stone redoubt guarding the Pale-Abyss Ice-Seal catalyst needed to open Portal #7. Smash their devilish garrison and seize the catalyst for The Pale Abyss.

locations.playerDescription: Jagged spiked iron battlements and frost-glazed black stone mark the seat of the self-proclaimed northern warlord. Rebels gather along its frozen approaches while drums echo from a bloodstained ice fighting pit within.

locations.name: The Pale Abyss
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #7
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #7 in Zone 18 (Lv 86–90) of Frostbound Reach. Frost-rimmed basalt archway into the Nine Hells — requires the Pale-Abyss Ice-Seal catalyst from Bleakwatch Citadel's Pale-Abyss Vanguard Redoubt.

bossInfo.plane: The Nine Hells & The Abyss (Frozen Pit)

locations.playerDescription: A frost-choked arch of black basalt breathing freezing hellfire from the deepest pits of the Abyss. Defectors from Bleakwatch whisper of an ice-locked seal held behind the warlord's bridgehead bastions.

locations.name: Ashenford War-Camp
locations.kind: Final War-Camp Hub
locations.description: Forward rebel base dug into the volcanic Dreadwaste scree border ahead of the mountain pass gates.

quests.title: Hold the Ash-Wall
quests.description: Garrick's armored wight legion and an ash-shrouded Lich commander are marching across volcanic wastes to overrun Ashenford's forward sandbag earthworks. Stand at the blackened steel pike trench and halt the undead advance.

quests.title: Consecrate the Sentry Posts
quests.description: Creeping pale violet mist rolling off the Dreadwaste darkened Ashenford's perimeter braziers, letting wraiths slip inside watch lines. Defeat the greater wraith and wisps haunting the sentry posts so chaplains can consecrate them anew.

quests.title: Siege-Alchemist's Powder
quests.description: Escort ironbound black-powder wagons across black ash flatlands to the forward catapult battery before ravenous ghasts and undead wights tear through the escort shields.

quests.title: Intercept Eclipse Supply Carts
quests.description: Black-robed Eclipse acolytes haul ground bone-powder canisters under escort of ghouls down the scarred ash trail toward Black Keep. Ambush their supply convoy and scatter the cursed reagents.

quests.title: Clear the Burned Ridge
quests.description: Every fallen soldier buried along the scarred ash ridge is clawing back through soot under Garrick's Shadowfell pulse. Sweep the bone-strewn hillside and put the risen legion back to rest.

locations.playerDescription: Iron-ribbed command tents and glowing siege braziers stand stubbornly upon black volcanic ash where rebel banners prepare the final push. Armorers and mystics arm champions for the shadowed siege ahead.

locations.name: The Eclipse Gate
locations.kind: Portal Dungeon #8 (King Garrick)
locations.description: Portal Dungeon #8 in Zone 20 (Lv 96–99) inside Black Keep. Final obsidian temple gate guarded by King Garrick — requires the Interlocking Wolf Pendant catalyst (stolen from Valen after Koren's death and entrusted to the Abyssal Eclipse Guard) from Unbind the Final Ward-Seal.

bossInfo.boss: King Garrick, Sovereign of the Undead Eclipse (2 Phases)

locations.playerDescription: A colossal temple archway of blackened silver and volcanic stone tearing open toward the Shadowfell itself. Heavy eclipse-wards lock the threshold; only breaking the inner throne seals will force the final gate wide.

locations.name: Garrick's Black Keep
locations.kind: Final Stronghold
locations.description: King Garrick's towering volcanic basalt stronghold where all 6 heroes reunite for the final campaign siege.

bossInfo.boss: Leads Directly Into King Garrick Finale

quests.title: Breach the Outer Obsidian Gate
quests.description: Your two heroes holding Highcrown Keep arrive at the gates just as Garrick's elite armored Wight shield-wall slams the outer portcullis down. Smash the armored honor guard and unite all six companions inside the keep.

quests.title: Destroy the Three Necrotic Obelisks
quests.description: Three crackling Shadowfell obelisks in the middle ward keep Garrick's throne doors sealed behind impervious violet wards. Defeat the Elder Vampire and wraith guards defending the plaza so Ellowyn can shatter their wards.

quests.title: Hunt the Undead Lich Lieutenants
quests.description: Garrick's three most ruthless lieutenants—men who once broke bread beside Valen and Koren before twisting into undead knights—hold the inner parade ground. Duel all three captains before they flank your final push.

quests.title: Honor Fallen Loyalist Banners
quests.description: Along the upper rampart walk hang the captured blue-and-silver house banners of every regiment that fell fighting Garrick's betrayal. Cut down the Vampire Champions mocking those relics and bear the standards with honor.

quests.title: Unbind the Final Ward-Seal
quests.reward: 30,000s | 15,000 XP + Interlocking Wolf Pendant | Mythic Draft
quests.description: After Koren's death in Highcrown's coliseum, King Garrick tore Valen's joined Interlocking Wolf Pendant from the boy's hand and later bound that silver heirloom to the Abyssal Eclipse Guard holding Black Keep's upper sanctum stairs. Smash the Eclipse Guard and reclaim the Interlocking Wolf Pendant to awaken Portal #8 and confront King Garrick inside The Eclipse Gate.

locations.playerDescription: Spired in volcanic black basalt beneath an eclipsed twilight sky, King Garrick's dark fortress towers over the scarred ashlands. Inside its breached outer bailey gather Ethoria's vanguard for the final reckoning.

locations.name: Crownlands Hill-Fort
locations.kind: Border Watch-Fort
locations.description: Timber-and-stone eastern border watch-fort guarding the hills near The Ashen Gate.

quests.title: The Stolen Ribbon
quests.description: Cutthroats holding a captured hill-fort courier—and Valen's prized crimson arena keepsake—fortified a thorn-choked limestone cave in the eastern hills. Fight past the spiked barricade and free the courier.

quests.title: Animated Sentinels of the Knoll
quests.description: Residual Earth-Plane tremors spilling from The Ashen Gate have awakened derelict stone-and-iron war prototypes atop the grassy western knoll. Smash the towering Shield Guardian before it marches on the hill-fort gates.

quests.title: Rust Monsters at the Munitions Dump
quests.description: Chittering rift creatures that melt forged steel on touch have burrowed under the fort's forward munitions depot cave. Exterminate the chitinous nest and save the remaining halberd crates before everything turns to red powder.

quests.title: Signal Fires on the Ridge
quests.description: Dusk patrols of rock-camouflaged gricks and swooping gargoyles keep snuffing out the hill-fort's early warning brazier near Portal #1. Defend the rocky beacon ledge until the watch signal burns clear across the Crownlands.

locations.playerDescription: Timber palisades and dressed stone parapets crown these rocky hills where royal outriders watch for tremors from the wilds. Cracked beacons and rusting halberd crates speak to nights spent holding back creatures of living iron.

locations.name: Meadowbrook Hamlet
locations.kind: Farming Village
locations.description: Sunny meadow agricultural village flanked by split-rail sheep pastures and wheat barns.

quests.title: Wolves in the Sheepfold
quests.description: Hungry timber wolves driven down from the eastern hills have broken through the split-rail fences of the hamlet's outlying sheep barn. Hold the timber barn door until the herders drive the last flocks inside.

quests.title: Stolen Plough-Iron
quests.description: Iron-thieving thugs hid Meadowbrook's spring ploughshares inside a stony hillside burrow only to get webbed up by nesting giant spiders. Cut open the silk-choked burrow and haul the town's metalwork back.

quests.title: Burned Granary Ledger
quests.description: Someone torched Meadowbrook's tax barn right after stealing the village tithe box, hoping fire would hide the theft. Follow soot-stained wagon ruts into the brush clearing and recover the bailiff's ledger from the bandit lieutenant.

quests.title: Seed Caravan to Oakhaven
quests.description: Wild blades animated by rogue Ashen Gate magic have pinned down the spring seed caravan halfway along the sunny wheat lane to Oakhaven. Smash the floating steel ambushers and clear the wagon turn.

locations.playerDescription: Split-rail pastures and timber wheat barns ring this peaceful hamlet tucked among sunlit green hills. Since unnatural beasts began prowling closer to the flocks, village herders keep lanterns burning well past dusk.

locations.name: Brinecliff Watch-Fort
locations.kind: Coastal Cliff Fort
locations.description: Limestone sea-cliff patrol fort watching coastal reefs and smuggler coves.

quests.title: Tide-Watcher's Cache
quests.description: Smugglers hid the navy's missing brass compass chest inside a dry sandstone cave mouth overlooking the Brinecliff headland. Slip inside, defeat the abyssal water weird coiled around the chest, and reclaim the relic.

quests.title: Merrow Raiders on the Breakwater
quests.description: Scaly merrow war-bands have been hauling themselves up the lower limestone headland steps under cover of sea spray. Hold the rocky breakwater wall before they breach the fort's seaward stair.

quests.title: Reef-Shattered Corsair Wreck
quests.description: A shattered corsair wreck wedged upon coastal reef stones still holds watertight powder kegs and brass spyglasses. Defeat the sea hag coven haunting the splintered hull to recover the naval stores.

quests.title: Sea-Hag Hollow on the Cliffs
quests.description: Every misty evening a coven hangs driftwood bone chimes from a cliff hollow north of the fort, hexing the watch sentries asleep. Smash their caustic cauldron and banish the sea hag into the surf.

locations.playerDescription: Carved into pale salt-spray limestone overlooking jagged coastal shoals, this patrol fort watches smugglers' coves and mist-wrapped sea caves. Watchers keep oil braziers lit whenever strange shapes surface beyond the breakers.

locations.name: Reedfen Village
locations.kind: Saltmarsh Village
locations.description: Saltmarsh reed-thatch fishing village anchored on solid marsh turf with drying nets and skiffs.

quests.title: Lanterns in the Bog
quests.description: Fog rolled deep through the Reedfen marshes, swallowing a relief patrol whose lantern posts went dark. Slay the multi-headed marsh hydra stalking the flooded reed track so scouts can relight the route safely.

quests.title: Watchtower Braziers
quests.description: Marsh raiders overran the old coastal sandstone watchtower so Reedfen fishermen lose sight of safe shoals at nightfall. Defeat the beasts lurking around the tower yard so village wardens can restore the beacon.

quests.title: Poachers of the Reed-Beds
quests.description: Reedfen's fishermen keep waking to slashed net lines and missing skiffs along the southern reed hummocks. Corner the smuggler boss stockpiling stolen village gear on the dry mud knoll.

quests.title: Salt-Cured Rations to Mirewatch
quests.description: Mirewatch's garrison is down to moldy biscuit after storms blocked supply wagons. Haul sealed salt-cured barrels along the wet mud track and fight off the monstrous coastal cephalopod ambushing baggage carts near shore.

locations.playerDescription: Steep reed-thatched cottages cling to firm marsh turf surrounded by hanging nets, flat-bottomed skiffs, and willow haze. Fisherfolk mend gear by smoky lantern light while abyssal tides litter nearby shores with wreckage.

locations.name: Tidewater Keep
locations.kind: Coastal Sea-Wall Castle
locations.description: Coastal granite sea-wall castle guarding the treacherous approach to The Sunken Maw, with an inner courtyard sparring arena.

quests.title: Hold the Sea-Wall Gate
quests.description: Surging water elementals rolling straight out of the coastal surf have begun battering the stone outer causeway below Tidewater Keep. Hold the spiked barricades along the coastal road until the castle sappers reinforce the gate.

quests.title: Gibbering Horror in the Cellar
quests.description: Mad whispers drifting up from an old dry stone drainage cellar outside Tidewater Keep have driven scouts away from their patrol routes. Descend the mossy stone stairs toward the faint violet glow below and silence the bloated alpha mouther lurking inside.

quests.title: Sabotage the Black-Market Dock
quests.description: Renegade pirates allied with merrow raiders have been running gunpowder off a grounded warship hidden along the western headland cove. Defeat the smugglers guarding the wreck to end their coastal supply drops.

quests.title: Outer Abyssal Watch
quests.description: An ancient armored dragon turtle drawn out through The Sunken Maw claimed a rocky sandy cove outside Tidewater Keep, guarding the gleaming Abyssal Brine-Pearl catalyst required to open Portal #2. Break the sea-beast's steam-belching shell and claim the catalyst.

locations.playerDescription: Wave-scarred granite walls guard the outer headland where deep-sea storms beat ceaselessly against royal masonry. Veterans sharpen spears inside its chain-ringed courtyard while keeping tense watch toward the abyssal surf.

locations.name: Goldmoor Village
locations.kind: Highland Frontier Village
locations.description: Sunny golden-ochre highland farming settlement catching border skirmish spillover.

quests.title: Burned Banners
quests.description: House Hollowstone's men disguised themselves as Redmarch raiders to burn outlying golden-ochre wheat farms and blame the Crownlands rebels. Expose the pikeman commander amid the smoldering barn timbers.

quests.title: Cockatrices in the Pasture
quests.description: Spiteful feathered beasts slipped through a rift crack and began turning Goldmoor's prized sheep and shepherds into silent limestone statues. Clear the cackling cockatrice flock out of the highland pasture.

quests.title: Herders at Highland Camp
quests.description: Turncoat soldiers working for Lord Hollowstone rounded up four Goldmoor shepherds out on the pastures, locking them inside a hillside log pen for silver ransom alongside plundered wool-bales. Storm their camp and march the villagers safely home.

quests.title: Grain Harvest Guard
quests.description: Crossbow poachers riding hungry dire wolves plan to burn Goldmoor's autumn wheat stacks before harvest carts roll into town. Hold the open threshing yard until the last sheaves are hauled inside.

locations.playerDescription: Golden straw roofs and open timber stables sit tucked amidst rolling sweeps of highland grass and wind-bent barley. Farmers keep pitchforks close beside the hearth as border skirmishes stray ever nearer the pastures.

locations.name: Slatepeak Mining Fort
locations.kind: Mountain Quarry Fort
locations.description: Gray-slate quarry fortress overlooking Highland iron smelters and passes.

quests.title: Collapsed Shaft Four
quests.description: A stone-breathing iron gorgon rammed the main support beams of Shaft Four, sealing a dozen slate miners underground behind rubble. Charge down the ore-cart tracks, shatter the beast, and clear the exit.

quests.title: Toll at Slate-Crag Pass
quests.description: A bickering two-headed ettin staked out a stony ambush toll-camp beside the wagon pass to demand silver and roast oxen from passing supply trains. Topple the giant brute to secure the trade road between highland forts.

quests.title: Abandoned Mine Watch-Shack
quests.description: Giantkin strayed far down from the iron hills and squatted inside the boarded miner's watch-shack overlooking Slatepeak's lower adit. Evict the club-swinging hill giant before it caves in the roof timbers.

quests.title: Stolen Iron Ingots
quests.description: A marauding Frost Giant smashed open the fort's smelter cart and carried twenty bars of tempered highland steel into its mountain cleft. Reclaim the iron ingots before the giant melts them into war-mauls.

quests.title: Brown Bears in the Upper Adit
quests.description: Lured by sweet rations left inside the upper quarry lunch shed, an enormous brown bear matriarch and her cubs claimed the upper mining ledge. Drive the ferocious beasts back up into the high wilds.

locations.playerDescription: Set straight into chiseled slate crags, this soot-stained stronghold feeds armorers with smelted pig iron and whetstone. Miners now bar the deeper tunnels against lurking ridge beasts.

locations.name: Thornwall Border Castle
locations.kind: Border Castle
locations.description: Golden-hour border citadel holding the loyalist front line against House Hollowstone.

quests.title: Chain C1: Blood on the Watchtower
quests.description: House Hollowstone desecrated Rowan's childhood borderland lookout post after slaughtering Orin's forward garrison. Storm Widow's Watchtower, defeat their knight-captain, and reclaim the loyalist wolf-fang banner.

quests.title: Cliffside Artillery
quests.description: Tail-spined manticores roosted right behind the castle's heavy bronze hilltop catapult terrace, skewering every sapper sent to clear the sandbags. Retake the cliffside artillery platform.

quests.title: Hippogriff Eyrie Raid
quests.description: Swooping hippogriffs and griffons nesting atop the jagged slate spire rising near Thornwall have carried off four cavalry chargers in a week. Raid their windswept stone eyrie and scatter the winged predators.

quests.title: Siege-Arrows to the Bailey
quests.description: Run a fresh armored wagon of heavy iron-tipped ballista bolts across the highland moors toward Redmarch Bastion. Lanky green-skinned trolls wait along the boulder bends to tip the cart for scrap metal.

locations.playerDescription: Heavy highland granite walls frown across contested valleys toward House Hollowstone's lands. Loyalists hold its high battlements with grim resolve while signal fires flash warnings between watchtowers at dusk.

locations.name: Timberfall Village
locations.kind: Forest Logging Village
locations.description: Emerald forest sawyer settlement bordered by stacked pine timber and deep canopy trails.

quests.title: Shelter the Timber Yard
quests.description: A ferocious mated pair of towering owlbears has battered down half the sawyer yard's outer log gate after loggers felled near their nesting ridge. Hold the lantern-lit timber palisade while crews clear the stacks.

quests.title: Caught in the Canopy
quests.description: Three Timberfall fellers walked straight into a dark pine hollow draped floor-to-canopy in thick giant webs. Defeat the bloated ettercap and flickering phase spiders guarding the silk grove to rescue the trapped loggers.

quests.title: Clear the Woodland Beast Den
quests.description: Gnarled oak roots arch over a dark earthen cavern heaped with gnawed deer bones just off the upper lumber cut. Clean out the towering alpha owlbear before logging carts grind to a halt.

quests.title: Poachers at Outlaw Stockade
quests.description: Someone has been hijacking seasoned oak planks right off Timberfall's skidways to fortify a hidden outlaw ringwall deeper inside the green canopy. Tear down their stolen palisade and scatter the gang.

locations.playerDescription: Freshly cut cedar beams and mossy shingle roofs gather inside a sunlit clearing under towering woodland boughs. Foremen count every axe and lantern before dusk falls over the overgrown timber trails.

locations.name: Mosswood Hamlet
locations.kind: Woodland Hamlet
locations.description: Sun-dappled mossy glade hamlet tucked beside ancient standing stones and forest shrines.

quests.title: The Forgotten Pillar
quests.description: Plague-born rot has twisted the spirit dwelling inside the ancient moss-clad standing monolith deep in Mosswood's glade. Cleanse the circular forest altar and free the seed-stone relic bound within its roots.

quests.title: The Wandering Relic
quests.description: A heavy consecrated abbey bell vanished along the leafy cobblestone trail, only for scouts to spot its gleaming brass rim floating inside creeping chartreuse forest slime. Dissolve the cube and haul the relic back.

quests.title: Nightmare Howls in the Glade
quests.description: At twilight, eerie voices and bone-chilling howls drift out of a haunted toadstool ring outside Mosswood, luring travelers straight toward Rotspire's borders. Break the Night Hag's cursed glade.

quests.title: Pure Spring-Vials to Greenwarden
quests.description: Run wicker hampers of uncorrupted clear spring water along the winding mossy road toward Greenwarden Fort's quarantine medics before creeping gray oozes dissolve the wagon wheels.

locations.playerDescription: Cottages of weathered oak stone cluster gently around moss-cloaked monoliths older than the kingdom itself. Passing bards and hermits linger by the shrine spring even as creeping ooze threatens the quiet paths.

locations.name: Greenwarden Fort
locations.kind: Woodland Ranger Fort
locations.description: Oak-log ranger fortress holding the deep forest frontier before the darkened plague woods, with an inner sparring pit.

quests.title: Chain B2: Ghosts of Oakhollow
quests.description: Harlan's burned home hamlet still lies silent beneath mossy ash and dead twisted oak roots. Delve into the sunken cottage foundations to claim his family's brass amulet bell from the ochre plague-slime.

quests.title: Trapped Rangers in the Copse
quests.description: A three-ranger patrol surveying the blighted border trees was cornered beneath pulsing resinous hive-sacs suspended across dead pines. Defeat the phase spiders and ettercap handler haunting the copse to rescue the scouts.

quests.title: Purge the Blighted Thicket
quests.description: Whenever Greenwarden sentries approach the blighted treeline, toxic spore clouds drift through hollow fungal stalks while corrosive oozes ambush the patrol. Purge the black pudding and violet fungus infesting the clearing.

quests.title: Fortify the Outer Palisade
quests.description: Creeping heaps of rotting forest mulch animated by plague spores are pushing straight toward Greenwarden's incomplete outer log wall. Hold the timber breach-line until rangers sink the final oak stakes.

quests.title: Stolen Antitoxin Crates
quests.description: Ambulance porters dropped Greenwarden's sealed antitoxin chests while fleeing acid-spitting ochre jellies near the limestone sinks. Defeat the slime pair guarding the clearing so medics can recover the chests.

locations.playerDescription: Sharpened oak-log ramparts and watchtowers brace this forest redoubt holding the line between emerald glades and blighted undergrowth. Rangers pack antitoxin vials and hone broadheads beside an inner sparring pit.

locations.name: Blightwatch Keep
locations.kind: Frontier Quarantine Keep
locations.description: Stone quarantine fortress guarding the shadowed fungal woods approaching The Rotspire.

quests.title: Chain B3: Heart of the Mire
quests.description: Every root choked with chartreuse plague mist traces back to the deep root-chamber beneath Thornroot Cavern. Confront and slay the colossal shambling blight-mound at its heart to avenge Harlan's lost family.

quests.title: Voices in the Roots
quests.description: Night sentries swear they hear familiar loved ones whispering out from the dead gnarled trees near Blightwatch. Expose the cunning green hag weaving vocal illusions from her hollow-tree hutch.

quests.title: Burn the Spore Pits
quests.description: Toxic ooze creeps outward from shallow forest sink-fissures circling Blightwatch's outer wall. Defeat the gelatinous cube and gray ooze festering in the clearing to secure the quarantine perimeter.

quests.title: Hold the Quarantine Gate
quests.description: Corrupted dryads and creeping plant-horrors are assaulting Blightwatch's outer stone quarantine archway, bearing the pulsing Spore-Heart Amber catalyst required to unlock Portal #4. Break their vanguard at the gate and seize the catalyst for The Rotspire.

locations.playerDescription: Fierce pitch-braziers burn ceaselessly outside dark limestone walls shielding the borderlands from creeping fungal rot. Soldiers bolt the iron gates nightly against withered beasts emerging from the poisoned mist.

locations.name: Sunstone Caravan Post
locations.kind: Desert Trade Post
locations.description: Desert trade caravan stop tucked beside wind-carved dunes and sandstone water cellars.

quests.title: Water-Casks Across the Dune
quests.description: Dunespire's reserve cisterns are running dry under blistering winds. Escort iron-hooped water wagons across the golden sandstone defile where cursed lamia illusionists hunt with breathing hell hounds.

quests.title: Desert Nomad Raider Camp
quests.description: Whip-wielding slaver outriders pitch striped canvas awnings among the red-gold desert canyons beyond Sunstone to cage lone pilgrims. Smash their holding cages and scatter the outrider post.

quests.title: Fire Snakes at the Dry Wash
quests.description: Sand turned into fused black glass along the scorched caravan trail beyond Sunstone where fire-elemental snakes erupt from scorched rock cracks to boil camel water-skins. Seal the heat-vented gully.

quests.title: Wrecked Spice Carts
quests.description: A sudden haboob storm swallowed two spice-trade wagons half a league out from Sunstone, and cackling magma mephits now perch over the wreckage setting silk bales alight. Salvage the brass ledger chest before everything burns.

locations.playerDescription: Carved beside golden dunes above deep sandstone water cellars, this bustling caravanserai offers shade, cold well-water, and stout packs to merchants crossing shimmering wastes.

locations.name: Sandwall Citadel
locations.kind: Desert Garrison Citadel
locations.description: Sun-baked orange sandstone desert fortress holding the frontier approach against slavers and dragons, with a desert garrison arena.

quests.title: Scorched Dragon Lair
quests.description: A proud young red dragon roosts in a blistered black sandstone cavern overlooking Sandwall's outer patrol ridge, roasting cavalry squads that wander too close. Descend into the soot-stained cave and claim its silver hoard.

quests.title: Relight the Dune Beacons
quests.description: Heat-forged azer shock-troops and salamanders seized the cliffside brass mirror-beacon overlooking Sandwall's dunes. Defeat the elemental squad holding the tower so garrison signalmen can restore desert warnings.

quests.title: Break the Hell-Hound Pack
quests.description: Brimstone-breathing hell hounds slipped out of the basalt desert rim and began hunting courier mounts outside Sandwall Citadel's stables. Track the smoking pawprints to the alpha's rocky cleft.

quests.title: Munitions to Gilded Approach
quests.description: Haul armor-piercing scorpion bolts forward to the underground rebels hiding along the canyon road approaching The Gilded Auction Manor. Break through the prowling chimera guarding the pass.

locations.playerDescription: Sun-baked orange sandstone walls tower above desert canyons where free-town defenders hold back raiders and winged desert drakes. Soldiers drill beneath copper banners surrounding an open-air sand arena.

locations.name: Clearwater Lake Village
locations.kind: Alpine Lake Village
locations.description: Snow-free alpine lakeside fishing town resting beside crystal sapphire highland waters.

quests.title: Lightning at Cragwater Storm-Stone
quests.description: A twelve-legged sapphire behir coiled inside the carved ancient granite storm-stone circle along Clearwater's grassy shore, shooting arcs of lightning at fishermen. Slay the storm-fanged monster and calm the shrine.

quests.title: Sanctuary of the Lake
quests.description: A lightning-breathing young blue dragon descended onto the ancient weathered granite temple pillars resting beside Clearwater's meadows. Drive the dragon from the sacred stones to preserve pilgrims' shelter.

quests.title: Wyverns on the Lake Shore
quests.description: Venomous cliff wyverns swoop out of green granite peaks every morning to pluck fishermen right off Clearwater's lakeshore wooden boat landing. Bring down the alpha stinger-wyvern haunting the shoreline.

quests.title: Cornered Lakeside Foragers
quests.description: Wild herb foragers hiking the walkable grassy cove along Clearwater's shore got boxed against gray granite boulders by an aggressive blue dragon wyrmling. Scatter the crackling wyrmling and lead them back along the bank.

locations.playerDescription: Wooden piers reach into crystal sapphire alpine water ringed by evergreen meadows and gray granite peaks. Pilgrims and fishers pause in quiet comfort beneath clear mountain skies.

locations.name: Cragwatch Fort
locations.kind: Granite Mountain Fort
locations.description: Granite ridge garrison guarding lower highland wyrm territories and mountain passes.

quests.title: Stranded on Crag-Ledge
quests.description: Three high-trail mountain guides sent up to check beacon flags are trapped inside the sturdy timber cabin on Crag-Ledge by an aggressive horned wyvern. Drive off the winged terror and bring the guides down.

quests.title: Clear the Alpine Crag Bear Den
quests.description: A scarred giant bear drove off two fort hunting parties from its rocky granite fissure overhang, roaring whenever patrols march below. Clear the foul bone-strewn cave.

quests.title: Highland Marauder Camp
quests.description: Sellswords sworn to storm-spirits set up weapon racks and crimson war-banners in a hidden rocky canyon fold beyond Cragwatch. Raid their stone firepit camp before they hit Anvilhall ore wagons.

quests.title: Storm-Wards to Stormhold
quests.description: Haul grounded copper storm-ward poles along the wind-scoured granite ridge up to Stormhold Citadel's battlements. A lightning-drake waits above the hairpin cliffs to scatter your escort with thunderbolts.

locations.playerDescription: Dressed granite parapets stand exposed to biting alpine gales along treacherous ridge approaches. Garrison scouts maintain bright signal braziers and rope-bridges against highland giants and swooping beasts.

locations.name: Stormhold Citadel
locations.kind: Highland Storm Citadel
locations.description: Monumental storm-lashed granite citadel standing below The Storm-Crowned Spire, hosting a highland champion arena.

quests.title: Storm-Crag Dragon Roost
quests.description: An adult blue dragon claiming the jagged granite ledge above Stormhold sits atop a massive woven timber roost strewn with iridescent azure scales and cracked giant shells. Slay the brood-guardian before she hatches fresh wyrmlings.

quests.title: Behir Tunnel Breach
quests.description: An ancient twelve-legged behir chewed straight through granite bedrock below Stormhold's cellar foundation. Charge down into the glowing fissure outside the lower curtain wall and kill the worm-dragon.

quests.title: Battlements of Lightning
quests.description: Fierce storm clouds gathered above Stormhold as djinni skirmishers and adult wyverns launch coordinated strikes against the outer copper-warded ramparts. Hold the outer bastion until the gale passes.

quests.title: Silence the Storm-Giant Warband
quests.description: A towering storm-giant war-chief claimed the granite terrace outside Stormhold Citadel, clutching the crackling Storm-Crown Lodestone catalyst required to awaken Portal #6. Topple the colossus and claim the catalyst for The Storm-Crowned Spire.

locations.playerDescription: Crowned with weathered copper lightning-rods beneath gathering thunderheads, this monumental mountain citadel guards the high ridges. Champions gather inside its drenched stone ring to test steel before the storm-lit peaks.

locations.name: Frostmere Village
locations.kind: Frozen Lake Trapper Village
locations.description: Snowbound timber trapper village perched beside a frozen cobalt lake.

quests.title: Coal & Fur Crates
quests.description: Frostmere's logging pickets are nearly out of black stove-coal and cured wolf-pelts with gale-force frost closing in. Push past the alpha winter wolf ambush and deliver the warm cargo to the snowbound cabins.

quests.title: Frost-Bound Shoreline Wreck
quests.description: Crushed onto jagged shore-ice near Frostmere, an older cargo longship still holds crates of cured ermine pelts and stamped royal silver. Shatter the ice mephits and shadow demon lurking below deck.

quests.title: Trappers at the Frozen Shoreline
quests.description: Two trapper brothers hauling ice-fish nets along the frozen pine shoreline got treed atop broken boulders by an enormous white polar bear and prowling snow cat. Clear the bank and guide them back to Frostmere.

quests.title: Abyssal Blight in the Pelts
quests.description: Hulking Hezrou horrors burst from an ice crack beneath the outer curing sheds, tainting Frostmere's fur stores with choking demonic vapors. Cut down the beasts and their barbed devil overseer before winter pelts rot.

locations.playerDescription: Snow-weighted log cabins flicker warmly with amber hearthlight along the rim of a silent frozen lake. Trappers cure wolf pelts and trade heavy winter furs under frost-rimmed conifers.

locations.name: Glacierwatch Fort
locations.kind: Glacial Border Fort
locations.description: Frost-draped granite and dark iron border fortress anchored beside towering glacial ice cliffs.

quests.title: Heart of the Ice
quests.description: Deep inside the gleaming cobalt cavern known as Glacier Vault, a towering insectoid ice devil guards an infernal freezing engine widening winter storms across the bay. Defeat the ice devil to shatter its power and claim the crystal heartstone.

quests.title: Overrun Cliff Watch-Post
quests.description: Glacierwatch's outlying signal outpost stopped flashing torches three nights ago after a veiled fiend infiltrated the watchroom. Storm the icy ruin, break the succubus's enchantment, and free any surviving sentries.

quests.title: Vrock Screechers on the Wall
quests.description: Feather-shedding vrocks shriek down from cobalt glacier ledges every dawn to stun fort archers with sonic wails. Defeat the winged fiends and their bone-devil handler along the ice crag.

quests.title: Hold the Glacier Ramparts
quests.description: A four-armed glabrezu demon leading horned shock-infantry is smashing straight through the snowy trench barricades outside Glacierwatch Fort. Hold the outer approach until sappers seal the ice breach.

locations.playerDescription: Wedged beneath towering cliffs of translucent blue glacier ice, this dark granite fortress defies freezing gales and pale fiends alike. Cold clan banners fly proudly beside crackling iron watch-fires.

locations.name: Icecrest Holdfast
locations.kind: Northern Clan Holdfast
locations.description: Fortified northern clan stone lodge and ringwall defying Marshal Bleakwatch's levies.

quests.title: The Frozen Labor Camp
quests.description: Bleakwatch's allies force northern villagers captured in winter raids to mine iron inside a spiked snow stockade watched by a chain devil taskmaster. Defeat the fiend overseer in battle to liberate the prisoners.

quests.title: Saber-Tooth Trail
quests.description: Two colossal white-pelted saber-toothed cats have been picking off Icecrest timber sleighs right along the pine gorge. Hunt down the ambush pair so firewood can reach the clan hall again.

quests.title: Chain-Devil Slaver Convoy
quests.description: Scouts spotted a heavy iron-barred prisoner sled creaking toward The Pale Abyss with shackled northern clan captives aboard. Ambush the bone-devil escort along the snowy pass and break every chain.

quests.title: Clan Brazier Relics
quests.description: Fiends tore the ancestral bronze hearth-bowls out of Icecrest's elder cairns to freeze out clan morale. Defeat the barbed devil standing watch at the desecrated stone ring and haul the sacred braziers back.

locations.playerDescription: An ancient timber longhall ringed by stout clan fieldstone stands defiant amidst frozen pines. Free jarls and freed thralls share horn-mead and forge cold steel against Marshal Bleakwatch's rule.

locations.name: Cinderwatch Bastion
locations.kind: Volcanic Forward Bastion
locations.description: Volcanic basalt forward bastion holding ash-scree lines against Eclipse Cultists.

quests.title: Eclipse Cultist Cliff Altar
quests.description: Atop scarred black obsidian cliffs overlooking Cinderwatch, Eclipse high-priests chant over a cracked violet altar slab feeding spectral mists across the valley. Shatter the ritual platform.

quests.title: Turncoat Patrols on the Ridge
quests.description: Turncoat border riders allied with winged shadow-cloakers seized the basalt saddle road beyond Cinderwatch to cut off supply wagons. Clear their spiked checkpoint and seize their orders.

quests.title: Ghouls in the Ash Quarry
quests.description: Pack after pack of ravenous ghasts and ghouls burrowed into the stepped obsidian quarry pits below Cinderwatch, ambushing work gangs mining stone for bastion walls. Purge the ash pits clean.

quests.title: Hold the Ridge Signal Tower
quests.description: Translucent wraiths and living shadows swarm nightly up the jagged basalt ridge to choke the warning beacon linking Cinderwatch with Ashvale. Guard the fire-basket turret till dawn breaks.

locations.playerDescription: Jagged basalt walls anchor the smoking ash-scree borderlands where sentries hold back dark cultists and creeping shadow. Orange oil-lamps guide stragglers safely behind iron-shuttered gates.

locations.name: Ashvale Village
locations.kind: Ash-Basin Survivor Village
locations.description: Fortified ash-basin survivor town guarding routes toward the Dreadwaste War-Pit ruins.

quests.title: The Fallen Banner
quests.description: Vampire spawn seized an obsidian garrison sparring pit and planted Koren's stolen crimson royal banner in the dirt as a trophy. Storm the torchlit bleachers, cut down the blood-pit captain, and reclaim the guard standard.

quests.title: Chain D2: Shattered Sands
quests.description: Bearing the transfer papers captured back near Millbrook, enter the ash-choked border war-pit where Koren fought in his youth before his transfer to Highcrown's Great Coliseum. Break his former warders' undead champions and claim the Coliseum Blood-Stone.

quests.title: Escort Ashvale Survivors
quests.description: Mounted wight lancers have pinned half a dozen Ashvale refugee carts behind a low black basalt road wall outside town. Scatter the undead riders and bring the survivors inside the palisade.

quests.title: Spectral Wails in the Ruins
quests.description: Haunting shrieks drifting across from the charred stone chapel shells outside Ashvale freeze watch sentries stiff with terror. Consecrate the ashes and disperse the sorrowful ghost choir.

quests.title: Recover Fallen Knight Medallions
quests.description: Before King Garrick closed the Eclipse Gate, royalist knights died holding the ash cairns outside Ashvale. Gather their tarnished silver house medallions from under hunting shadows so their families know their fate.

locations.playerDescription: Squat stone cottages lit by stubborn candlelight shelter displaced families and weathered veterans amidst soot-covered hills. Elders guard tattered royal archives and tend wounded travelers.

locations.name: Scorchwall Fort
locations.kind: Obsidian Coastal Fort
locations.description: Obsidian coastal fort overlooking the haunted ash bay and Zone 20 approaches toward Black Keep.

quests.title: Prisoners of the Oathbreakers
quests.description: Missing reconnaissance scouts dragged across the volcanic crags are trapped behind iron grates inside an ancient locked catacomb pavilion leading toward The Bone Reliquary. Silence the wailing ghosts haunting the blue-lit entrance and break open the grate to free the survivors.

quests.title: Lord of the Crypt
quests.description: Beneath bleak basalt tomb pillars burns an ancient crimson covenant feeding undead hordes across the Dreadwaste. Descend to the deepest vault of The Bone Reliquary and stake the Elder Vampire Lord.

quests.title: Wreck of the Shadow-Fleet
quests.description: A cursed black-timbered flagship hauling blackmail tribute ran hard ashore onto jagged obsidian reefs along the volcanic coast. Hike out to the stranded hull, slay its nocturnal vampire crew, and seize the treasury chest.

quests.title: Hold the Bay Watch-Wall
quests.description: An isolated coastal watch-wall perched out on the jagged sea-cliffs keeps spectral wraiths from drifting inland off the ash bay fog each night. Travel out to the lonely headland parapet, keep its consecrated signal braziers burning, and break the midnight wraith assault.

locations.playerDescription: Perched above dark haunted swells beside smoking volcanic bluffs, this fortress overlooks the final bleak approaches toward Black Keep. Royal scholars and hardened blades watch the horizon around blazing iron cages.
